seo.title: Book a Free Consultation | Legal Dispute Help
seo.description: Book a free initial assessment with Legal Dispute Help. Describe your situation and we'll assess the evidence, deadlines and available paths, with rough costs for each.

hero.headline: Book a free initial conversation
hero.subheadline: Fill in the form below. Try to include what happened, the amounts involved and the key dates — the more specific the information, the more useful our initial view.

trust.title: What the first conversation covers
items: Hearing your full account, in Chinese
Building a timeline and listing the documents you hold
Explaining how matters like this usually proceed and what is typically needed
Identifying whether a licensed attorney needs to be involved
Where needed, recommending a suitable partner law firm

privacyNote: The information you provide is used only to understand your enquiry. Legal Dispute Help is not a law firm; submitting this form does not create an engagement or an attorney-client relationship.
